A box that is optional, short, and after the exercise (never in front of it) does not get in the way of the work.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/models/rating_test.rb` (the append-only triggers, the CHECKs, latest wins, the averages, the scopes), `test/integration/ratings_test.rb` (an exercise rated after it is over, solution shown, tries used up, an open one refused, stars alone, words alone, neither, 2000 and 2001 characters, a repeat, another student's id, a later rating, another student's serve and a withdrawn release, a trial student and the English page, a lesson and a wrong revision or topic, the teacher, a guest, an unmapped login, nobody, the preview and the API listener refused, CSRF, the preview student itself, nothing else written, the markup of the box on the practice page and both lesson pages, none in the preview, the entry test and the other pages), `test/integration/teacher_ratings_test.rb` (the page, the averages, the filters, the menu, the guest, a view link, the lines on the topic page and the item card), `test/integration/public_api_ratings_test.rb` (bot_read and teacher read, the three content roles refused, the filters, the refusals), `test/models/privacy/student_export_test.rb` (the table in the export), `test/lib/locale_parity_test.rb` (`ratings.{it,en}.yml`), `test/system/ratings_test.rb` (Cuprite on a 390 px phone: the practice page, the end of a lesson/2 and of a lesson/1, every text size), `cli/cmd_ratings_test.go`.

## D-369 · 2026-11-19 · robustness: the backup seen from health, the failed jobs, the TTS memory

- **Design ref:** D-007 (backups are local only: nothing here copies anything off the machine), D-065 and D-153 (`Health`, what gates), D-359 (the voices: `Speech::Plan`, the clip key `sha256(engine|voice|text)`), D-327 (a `bot_read` or `teacher` token sees the report redacted), the advisory report of 2026-11-19 (§S7).
- **What the operator saw (2026-11-19):** `banco health` said `backup: not_configured` because the container has no `BANCO_BACKUP_DIR` while the real backup runs on the host (`banco/backup.sh`, cron 02:30): the copy of 2026-11-13 is missing and nothing in banco noticed; a `SpeakLessonRevisionJob` that uses its 6 attempts disappears; `banco-tts` was OOM-killed at 2 GB and three times at 6 GB (anon-rss 6.2 GB) under the speech backfill.
- **We do:**
  1. **`Health#backup` reads what the host writes.** `backup.sh` writes `backup/banco/YYYY-MM-DD/production*.sqlite3.gz`, one directory per day; `Health#backup` took only the files directly in the directory and would have said `missing` for ever. It now takes the newest file of the directory and of the directories one level down (hidden entries, the script's `.tmp.*` working directory, never count), and reports `{status, age_hours, max_age_hours: 36, newest: "2026-11-19/production.sqlite3.gz", newest_mb}`; `stale` after 36 h, `missing` when there is no file (a lost mount fails, it is not `not_configured`). It only lists and stats: the directory is mounted **read-only** into the container.
  2. **`Health#jobs`** (a new part, informational like `validation_queue`, it never turns `ok` false and never fails the preflight): `failed_24h: {total, by_class}` (the `SolidQueue::FailedExecution` rows of the last 24 h by job class) and `speech: {ready, scheduled, oldest_ready_minutes}` (the backlog of the `speech` queue: ready to run, waiting for a retry, the age of the oldest ready one); `not_applicable` outside Solid Queue. It appears in `banco health --json` and `bin/preflight`.
  3. **One line in «Da fare adesso»** (the teacher's home and `GET /api/v1/teacher/home`, kinds `jobs` and `backup`, Italian text in `teacher.dashboard.todo.*`): «N lavori in background sono falliti nelle ultime 24 ore: SpeakLessonRevisionJob (2).» and, when the backup is late or missing, «L'ultima copia di sicurezza ha 40 ore.» / «Non trovo nessuna copia di sicurezza.». Nothing when all is well; nothing of it reaches the student.
  4. **The TTS service grows no more** (`services/tts/server.py`, `docs/tts.md`): (a) the onnxruntime session is built with `enable_cpu_mem_arena = False` and `enable_mem_pattern = False` (`kokoro-onnx` 0.4.7 builds the session inside `Kokoro(...)` with no options, so the session is created here and given to `Kokoro.from_session`); (b) a text is split into sentences (`split_text`: at `. ! ? …` before a capital, a digit, `¿`, `¡` or an opening quote, at newlines, then at clause marks and spaces for a sentence over 200 characters; a piece under 24 characters joins its neighbour), each is synthesized on its own and the audio is joined with 0.15 s of silence; (c) the model lives in a spawned worker process that the service replaces after `BANCO_TTS_RECYCLE_AFTER` sentences (100) or when its resident set reaches `BANCO_TTS_RECYCLE_RSS_MB` (1500 MiB), loading the next one in the background; a worker that dies or does not answer in 120 s is replaced and the sentence tried once more; (d) `MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2` in the image. `/health` shows `worker: {runs, rss_mb, recycled}`.
- **Not done / must not change:** the clip key and the formula (`Speech::Key`), `Speech::Plan` and the segment texts, the 1000-character limit of a request, the voices, `Speech::Client`, the `speech_clips` rows: only the audio of a clip with several sentences differs (a short pause between sentences, which the model had put there by itself). The ledger, the engine and the student's pages are untouched; no backup is made, moved or deleted here, and a second copy on another disk (inside D-007) is still the operator's to do. `Health` does not turn red for a failed job or a deep speech backlog: a backfill makes a backlog on purpose, and a transient failure must not stop a deploy.
- **What the operator adds on the host (not in this repository):** in `docker-compose.yml`, service `banco`: `environment: - BANCO_BACKUP_DIR=/backup` and `volumes: - /home/nik/traefik/backup/banco:/backup:ro` (the container user is uid 1000, like `nik`, who owns the 0700 day directories); then `docker compose up -d --no-deps banco`. For `banco-tts`: rebuild the image, keep `mem_limit: 6g` until `docker stats banco-tts` and `/health` (`rss_mb`) stay flat through one `bin/rails banco:speech:backfill CONFIRM=1`, then `mem_limit: 3g` and `memswap_limit: 3g`; optionally `BANCO_TTS_RECYCLE_AFTER` and `BANCO_TTS_RECYCLE_RSS_MB`.
- **Why:** a backup nobody sees fail is the risk D-007 accepted, made worse; `Health` should know what the host's cron did. The failed job is the other silent one. For the TTS the cause is how onnxruntime's allocator keeps what the longest input needed (the model's input length changes with every sentence), so the fix is to give it no arena, short inputs, and a process that is thrown away before it grows, the pattern gunicorn's `max_requests` is for.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/integration/health_test.rb` (the day directories, a read-only directory, the working directory ignored, stale after 36 h, a lost directory, `jobs` with and without Solid Queue), `test/integration/teacher_dashboard_test.rb` (the two lines), `services/tts/test_server.py` (`python3 -m unittest test_server`: the splitting, the join, the session options, the worker loop, the recycling).
## D-371 · 2026-11-19 · what the teacher needs to answer a comment: context, the 24 h clock, a tone lint

- **Design ref:** D-304 (comments), D-327 (token roles: the teacher token replies, a reader reads), D-346 (his raw words in the tries: the teacher token only), D-349 (the answer time of 24 hours, «In ritardo»), D-361 (2000 characters), D-337 (his reading difficulties), firm rule 1 (no model, and nothing in the student's path), firm rule 2 (a reply is not a decision), firm rule 4 (append-only).
- **The operator's wish (2026-11-19, from the advisory report §S5):** the first answers came 36 h after the comments of 17 November against the 24 h we declared; 25 answers went out in 59 seconds; the answers inside a thread came 4 to 7 hours later with a worse tone; he takes wording such as «se ricordi cosa volevi dire» or «il tuo browser teneva le icone» as an accusation; two answers sat unread for 26 days. The bot writes the drafts and the operator reviews them: the tools must show what the teacher needs, and warn, never decide.
- **We do (operator tooling only; nothing here reaches the student but the teacher's own text):**
  1. **The `context` block** of `GET /api/v1/comments/:id`, of `banco comments show` and of `bin/rails banco:comments:show` (`Comments::Context`, the one builder; read-only, nothing recorded). (a) `revision`: for an exercise `item`, for a lesson `lesson`: the revision he saw against the newest of the same item or lesson, with `note` «changed since: rev N» or «unchanged: rev N». (b) `tries`: his answers behind the comment (`Attempts::Log` with the comment filter of D-346: the serve, else the instance, else the card and block of a lesson) and, for an exercise, his other recent tries on the item; the raw words (`answer`, `anchor_row`) only for a `teacher` token (`words: true`) and in the operator's console, never for a `bot_read` token (`words: false`). (c) `earlier_comments`: up to 20 earlier comments on the same item (the same page when the comment has no item), with the teacher's replies. (d) `reply`: `within_hours`, `waiting`, `waiting_since`, `due_in_hours`, `late`, `student_followup`. A key with nothing to say is absent.
  2. **The 24 h clock counts from the first student message without a teacher reply after it** (`Comment#waiting_since`; before it was his last message, so a second follow-up restarted the clock and hid the delay). `due_in_hours` is `waiting_since + 24 h − now` in hours, to a tenth, negative once late (`Comments::ReplyWindow.due_in_hours`); `late?`, the «In ritardo» mark and its count follow the same moment. `student_followup` means he wrote after the teacher's last reply and has had no answer since. The comment rows of `GET /api/v1/comments` carry `due_in_hours` and `student_followup` while the comment waits.
  3. **A tone lint, advisory, never blocking** (`Comments::ReplyLint`, `config/banco/reply_lint.yml`). The file lists phrases that read as blaming him: «hai sbagliato», «il tuo browser», «il tuo dispositivo», «tuo dispositivo», «se ricordi», «ti ricordi», «non hai letto», «era finito il tempo», «è scaduto il tempo», «devi», «avresti dovuto», «non è vero»; they are matched as whole words, in any case, with a phrase inside a longer matched one (`tuo dispositivo` in `il tuo dispositivo`) warned once; and `max_characters: 600`. A reply that has a phrase or is longer than 600 characters gets a warning `{code: blaming_phrase|too_long, message, phrase | length, max}`. `Comments::Console` returns `warnings` with every reply, dry run or confirmed; the API answers `warnings` (an empty list when the reply reads fine) in both; `banco comments reply` prints each as a `warning:` line on stderr, and with `--confirm` first sends the dry run of the same reply, prints the warnings, and then sends (one extra dry-run request; a refused dry run stops the send); `bin/rails banco:comments:reply` prints them before it calls the console, `CONFIRM=1` still sends. The reply is sent as written; the lint changes nothing and refuses nothing. A phrase is added when a reply was taken the wrong way; the list is not shortened without a decision. The lint is not in the teacher's browser form.
  4. **«In scadenza»** (`Comments::Due`): the threads that wait for the teacher with the hours left, the soonest due first (the late ones at the top), and which of them are a follow-up after the teacher's last reply. In the teacher's inbox (`/teacher/comments`, a panel above the filters that does not follow them; a guest does not see it; texts in `teacher_comments.it.yml`, `teacher.comments.due.*`) and in `GET /api/v1/digest` / `banco digest` as `comments.due` (`within_hours`, `waiting`, `late`, `followups` for all, `rows` for the first 20).
- **Not done / must not change:** no notification (e-mail, push, in-app) to the teacher or the student; no bot sends a reply without the teacher's `--confirm`; the lint is advice (it does not block, does not rewrite, does not score, is not shown to the student); no new route, no new command in `contract/commands.json` (the answers of `comments show`, `comments reply` and `digest` grow); no new table or column; the student's two reading sides (the comment page, Oggi) are untouched; the opening that repeats his error (named in the report) is not linted.
- **Why:** the delay and the tone were the two things he held against the teacher in his comments, and both were visible only after the fact. Showing the hours left, from the moment he started waiting, makes the late thread impossible to miss; showing the revision he saw against the newest says whether the defect he reported is already fixed; and a list of the phrases he took as an accusation, checked before sending, costs one second of reading. A lint that blocks would make the operator fight the tool; one that only warns is read.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/integration/reply_support_test.rb` (the context for the item and lesson revision, the teacher token's words and the bot_read token's none, the earlier comments, the due hours from the first unanswered message and the follow-up, the lint on every seeded phrase and on 600/601 characters, the API's dry run and confirmed reply with warnings that still send, the console, the rake tasks, the digest's `due`, the inbox's «In scadenza» and the guest's none, the late mark of a thread), `cli/cmd_decisions_test.go` (warnings on stderr in the dry run, before the send with `--confirm`, a refused dry run stops it, the context and `due` passed through).
## D-368 · 2026-11-19 · «Contestazioni»: where the grader may be wrong

- **Design ref:** D-346 (the student's answers over the API: the student's own words only to a `teacher` token), D-327 (token roles), D-339 (whole sentence, near text, «Fai controllare», the repeated answer refused), D-352 (`resolve_attempt` on a practice try, a whole sentence round the blank), D-353 (`same_answer`), D-332 (a view link reads like a guest), D-365 (the model of a read-only page and its API and CLI), firm rule 1 (no model in the student's path), firm rule 2 (no decision, no write), firm rule 4 (no table), firm rule 6 (English code and keys, Italian texts for the teacher).
- **Why (advisory report of 2026-11-19, §S1):** 8 of 15 written answers were right and were corrected by hand (53%), 19 identical resends, and D-339 and D-352 arrived after he suffered them: nothing told the teacher where the grader was wrong before he said so; it was found from three comments. A monitor reads the ledger the grader and the teacher already wrote and puts the doubtful tries and exercises first, so the grader's weak spots come to the teacher, not the other way round.
- **We do:**
  1. **A read model, `Teacher::GradingReview`** (`app/models/teacher/grading_review.rb`), over `Attempts::Log` (`Practice::AttemptLog` and `Attempts::DiagnosisLog`: the rows the teacher bot already reads, with `Practice::Resolutions` and the entry test's `resolve_attempt` decisions, `PracticeContest` and the student's comments). No new table, no migration, no write, no decision; it is derived at read time, so it is not retroactive (what D-339, D-352 and D-353 fixed shows only in later tries). A **try** is a practice try the engine graded or an entry-test answer that is not «non lo so» (and was graded); it is **not right** when the grader did not call it right, whatever the teacher said afterwards (a resolved try keeps the grader's own outcome). Only the **current revision** of an exercise is read: a try on an older revision is left out and counted in `totals.superseded`, because the fix is the revision.
  2. **The signals of a not-right try:** `full_sentence` (a whole sentence that holds all the words of the key or an accepted form, in order, with other words round them); `near_text` (the whole answer is 1 or 2 Damerau edits from the key or an accepted form of 5 letters or more); `resend` (the same answer, as `Practice::AnswerRecorder` reads it, was already sent for this exercise instance; since D-339 the app refuses an identical answer and stores nothing, so it shows only in older tries and in a redo of the same instance); `contested` («Fai controllare»); `comment` (a comment of the student that is not a «mi piace», written at or after the try, on its serve or its exercise, or, when it names no exercise, on its practice page within an hour of it); `resolved_right` (a teacher `resolve_attempt` made it right). A signal says where to look; it is not a verdict.
  3. **Per exercise:** the tries, the not-right tries and their rate, the manual corrections (a `resolve_attempt` of any verdict on one of its tries) and their rate, the resends, the contested ones and the tries with a signal. **«Da controllare» (`flagged`) when it has at least 5 tries and more than half not right (`many_not_right`), or at least one manual correction (`manual_correction`).** The thresholds are high on purpose: a wrong alarm costs the teacher's attention. The totals give the weekly measure of the report: written tries not right and their rate, manual corrections, identical resends, contested.
  4. **Surfaces:** the teacher's page `/teacher/grading` («Contestazioni», in the menu; `Teacher::GradingController`; teacher, guest and view link, filters `subject` and `since`, `?student=` as every teacher page; **a guest and a view link never see what the student typed**); `GET /api/v1/grading/review[?since=&subject=&student=]` (`Api::V1::GradingReviewController`, `bot_read` and `teacher` tokens, a content agent's token is `403 E-AUTH`; **a `bot_read` token gets the same rows without `answer`**, the D-346 rule, and `includes_answers` says so); the CLI `banco grading review [--since --subject --student --json]` (`cli/cmd_grading.go`, `contract/commands.json`); `docs/api.md` «Where the grader may be wrong», `docs/bot.md`.
  5. **Candidate vectors:** `bin/rails banco:grading:vectors [STUDENT=student]` (`lib/tasks/grading.rake`, `Teacher::GradingVectors`) prints, as JSON, one case in the shape of `test/fixtures/grading/vectors.json` (`id` `resolved-practice-N` or `resolved-diagnosis-N`, `component`, `raw` with the shown ids mapped back to the instance's own and structured answers as JSON values, `item` = the spec and the key, `expect` = the verdict the teacher gave) for every `resolve_attempt` that made an answer right, practice try or entry-test answer; a case whose id is already in the file is left out. **Print only**: the operator reviews the words and pastes what he keeps; nothing is written to the file or the database.
- **Not done / must not change:** no write, no decision, no table, no effect on the grader, the engine, the fold, a gate or the digest; no model reads anything (rule 1); the monitor never re-grades a try and never changes a verdict (a correction is still the teacher's `resolve_attempt`, rule 2); nothing reaches the student. The lesson checks' answers are not read (they have no teacher resolution). A signal is a pointer, not evidence: the thresholds may be tuned by a new decision.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/models/teacher/grading_review_test.rb` (the world of `test/support/grading_review_world.rb`: a sentence made right by the teacher, contested, sent twice, a whole sentence, a typo, a comment, a number item at exactly half, a superseded revision, the entry test: every signal, the item rows and the flag boundaries, the totals, `since` and the subject, the answers in or out, nothing written), `test/models/teacher/grading_vectors_test.rb` (the cases, the shared file's shape, a vector the grader fails today, the ids already in the file, `banco:grading:vectors` prints and writes nothing), `test/integration/teacher_grading_test.rb` (the page, the menu, the guest and the view link without the student's words, the filters), `test/integration/public_api_grading_review_test.rb` (the roles: teacher with the words, `bot_read` without, a content agent refused; the filters and the refusals), `cli/cmd_grading_test.go`.
## D-366 · 2026-11-19 · one right answer moves to the next exercise (`practice/6`), and a topic that is finished says so

- **Design ref:** D-235 and `docs/rules/practice-5.md` (the rules the selector followed), D-341 and D-348 (how a rules version is made: a new module, a new prose note, every reference moved, the old note stays as the record), D-348 (the line «esercizio simile», the pool that runs out), D-340 (what is missing to close a topic), D-325 and D-326 (a topic is `done` when every skill is demonstrated or consolidated, from the practice or from the entry test's seed), D-309 (the preview, `spath`), D-356 (the English twin), D-364 (the English walk), firm rule 1 (no model in the student's path).
- **The operator's approval (2026-11-19, the next steps taken from the advisory report):** with `ADVANCE_AFTER_CORRECT_UNAIDED` at 2 the selector keeps the student on one exercise until it has two right answers without help, so a skill needs four exercises even when every one is right (two on the first item, two on the second). The operator approved `ADVANCE_AFTER_CORRECT_UNAIDED` at 1, with the demonstration criteria exactly as they are (3 right footprints, 2 of them hard, `practice/5`), and a short closing screen when the practice of a topic is complete.
- **We do:**
  1. **Rules `practice/6`** (as D-341 made `practice/4` and D-348 made `practice/5`): `lib/practice/rules/v6.rb` (`Practice::Rules::V6`, the file `v5.rb` is renamed), `docs/rules/practice-6.md` (a new note; `practice-5.md` stays as the record), every reference moved (`V5` to `V6`, `practice/5` to `practice/6`, the contract example's `rules_version`), the drift test `test/lib/practice/rules_test.rb`. The one number that changes is `ADVANCE_AFTER_CORRECT_UNAIDED`, **2 to 1**: `Practice::Selector#next_unseen` (rule 6 of section 7) takes the current item as the first pinned item with fewer than 1 right try without help, so each right answer moves to the next item in pin order, and when every item has one the one served least recently. `DEMONSTRATE_CORRECT_UNAIDED` stays 3 and `DEMONSTRATE_MIN_LOW_GUESS` stays 2: three distinct exercises right without help, two of them hard to guess (`Diagnosis::Rules::V1.low_guess?`); the fold, the numbers and the states are not touched.
  2. **How the version applies.** The engine pins the version per serve (`practice_serves.rules_version`, written by `Selector#create_serve`), and nothing compares it with the current one. So serves already stored keep `practice/5`; every serve made after the deploy records `practice/6`; the selector reads the constant of the module it loads, so the new number applies to the next choice whatever the version of the serves behind it (a student halfway through a skill with one right try on the first item goes to the second item at the next call). No row is rewritten, no state is derived differently.
  3. **The line «esercizio simile»** (D-348, `Practice::Repeat`, `practice.same_item`): with the number at 1 it can appear only after a try that did not count on that item (wrong, aided, a solution), so the number is no longer in the text: «Ti propongo un esercizio simile: per passare al prossimo ne serve uno giusto.» (English «I am giving you a similar exercise: to move on to the next one you need one right.»); `Practice::Messages.same_item_it` no longer passes `n`.
  4. **The end of a topic.** `POST /practice/serves` without `item` answers `{type: "topic_done"}` when `Practice::Today.done?(topic, states)` (the meaning of «done» the course already uses: every skill `demonstrated` or `consolidated`, the entry test's seeds included), and serves nothing: no serve is created, no `PracticePoolExhaustion` is written, a resumable open serve is not resumed. The body carries the skill block (the page shows its state), `title_it` («Hai finito questo argomento!»), `offer_it` («Vuoi farne un altro? Eccolo:»), `next` (`topic`, `title_it`, `label_it` «Vai al prossimo argomento», `url`), `today` (`label_it` «Torna a Oggi», `url`). The next topic is **`Course::StudentView#next_topic(subject_view)`**, the topic Oggi proposes first for the subject and `banco next` gives (the topic he left when it is not done, else the first of Oggi's ranked suggestions of that subject, programme topics only); when none is left, `offer_it` and `next` are `null` and the screen has only the title and «Torna a Oggi». The addresses are made by the server with `student_root` (`/topics/KEY`, `/today`, or the preview's `/teacher/preview/...`); a script never writes a student address.
  5. **The page** (`practice/show.html.erb`, `practice_controller.js` `showTopicDone`): a hidden section `#topic-done` in the exercise's card with a title, a line naming the next topic, two buttons (`a.button`, the next topic first and primary; «Torna a Oggi» second) and, after them, an empty slot `#topic-done-extra`, where the Schemas slice adds «Vedi lo schema» (route `/topics/:topic_key/schema`); this decision links to nothing there. The state pill and the three dots still show the skill; the list of exercises stays drawn; it speaks of this topic only (no subject, no count, no progress). Texts `practice.topic_done.{title,offer,next,today}` in `course.it.yml` and `course.en.yml`; CSS `.topic-done` in `student.css` (rem lengths, the buttons wrap, 44 px targets).
  6. **Not a lock.** An exercise chosen from the list (`item`, «Rifai», «Già fatti») is served as before (rule 1 of section 7), and so is `?item=KEY`; when that exercise is over and he asks for the next, the screen comes back. A topic known from the entry test shows it as soon as he opens practice on it. The teacher's preview shows it too (the same controller, `spath`). The entry test, the lessons and the API are untouched.
- **Not done / must not change:** the criteria of demonstration (3 right, 2 hard), consolidation, `to_review`, the grading, the ledger and the engine's numbers other than the one above; the entry test; the topic page's step 2 (it still lists the skills and says «Esercitati»); a lock on the exercises; the link to a schema.
- **Why:** four exercises for three right answers made the student repeat the kind of exercise he had just done well, and a topic that never ends reads as a chore. A right answer is the signal to go on, and once the skills are shown the screen tells him he is done and offers the next topic, so he stops by himself instead of by being sent away.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/lib/practice/rules_test.rb` (the drift test on `practice-6.md`, the constant at 1, the demonstration numbers, `practice-5.md` kept, no `V5`), `test/lib/practice/properties_test.rb` (`PROP_RUNS=300`, the selector's properties hold), `test/models/practice/selector_test.rb` (one right moves to the next item, the least recently served comes next, the version recorded), `test/integration/practice_navigation_test.rb` (no line while each right answer moves on, the line after a solution, the new wording), `test/integration/practice_topic_done_test.rb` (the last skill demonstrated, then the screen with the next topic; this topic only; not a lock; a topic known from the entry test; an optional topic; no next topic; the English page; the markup and the free slot; the preview's addresses; the entry test knows nothing of it), `test/system/topic_done_test.rb` (390 px: the last exercise right, «Un altro esercizio», the screen, each button, for a trial student, the preview and English; no sideways scroll, 44 px), `test/system/english_walk_test.rb` (the screen in English, desktop and phone), `test/lib/locale_parity_test.rb` (the twin keys).
## D-370 · 2026-11-19 · a practice matching of more than 4 rows is warned, of more than 6 it is refused

- **Design ref:** D-297 (`W-INSTANCES-ALIKE`, the model of a cross-instance warning in `lib/validation/`), D-147, D-149 and D-154 (a revision that passed under older rules: informative, validated again only on an identical resubmission), D-093 and D-314 (the judge matching), `Diagnosis::Rules::V1::LOW_GUESS_MIN_MATCHING_PAIRS` (4), D-363 (the count line).
- **Found (advisory report of 2026-11-19, S6):** on matchings of 6 or 7 rows the student got 2 right out of 15 tries in practice, and 0 out of 8 on 6 rows in the entry test. The engine already counts a matching as hard to guess from 4 rows, so more rows give no more evidence, only a longer list to get through and tries used up (`MAX_WRONG_TRIES` 2).
- **We do:**
  1. **Two thresholds in the rules file:** `practice.matching_rows_warn: 4` and `practice.matching_rows_max: 6`. Rules version 11 to 12; error-code registry version 33 to 34.
  2. **`Validation::MatchingRows`** (called by `ItemRunner` beside `instances_alike`, for static items and for the clean seeds of a generated one): for a unit that is a `practice_item` with component `matching` (a judge, a right column of two options, is a matching too) it counts the left rows of every instance and adds ONE finding for the item, at `/instances`: `W-MATCHING-ROWS` (warning) when the most rows is above 4, and above 6 `E-MATCHING-ROWS` (error, no warning beside it) with the number of instances over the maximum and the most rows. A diagnosis item is not checked here (the entry test has no tries to use up).
  3. **New submissions only, as D-147/D-149/D-154 treat older rules.** `ValidateItemRevisionJob` validates a revision again only on an identical resubmission of one that passed under older rules (D-154). `Validation::RevisionValidation` hands `grandfathered: true` to the runner when the revision already has a `passed` validation: then more than 6 rows are reported as the warning only (its message says it passed under older rules) and the new validation passes. A revision never validated, a new revision of an old item and every dry run are new submissions and get the error. No stored verdict is rewritten: the append-only `item_validations` keep their rows, and a pass under rules 11 stays a pass (`older_rules`, informative).
  4. **The brief:** one line in `briefs/practice-item.md` (the rule, the split into two items, and that a practice judge has 4 rows).
  5. **The teacher's item card** (`Teacher::ItemCard`, `Card#rows`, the tag next to the seconds): «6 righe», or «4–6 righe» when the instances differ, only for a matching; read from every stored instance of the revision. `teacher.skill.rows` in `teacher.it.yml` (the teacher's pages are Italian only, D-356: no English twin).
  6. **A practice judge from 4 rows** (the operator approved «abbinamenti a 4 righe al massimo», judges included). `E-MATCHING-SIZE` asked 6 rows at least for a classification with two categories (D-093: 2^6 blind guesses), which made every judge exceed 4 rows. `practice.judge_min_rows: 4` in the rules file now replaces that 6 for a `practice_item` (`InstanceChecks#judge_min_rows`); "fewer categories than rows" is as before, and `W-MATCHING-JUDGE-ROWS` (D-314) still asks at least 2 rows of each option, so a practice judge of 4 rows is two and two. A judge of 3 rows is refused (`E-MATCHING-SIZE`); a judge over 4 rows warns like any matching. A diagnosis (entry-test) judge keeps 6 rows (`MIN_ROWS_TWO_CATEGORIES`).
  7. **The contract examples** carry rules version 12 (`rules_version` and `current_rules_version` in six files).
- **Not done / must not change:** the grader, the engine's rules (`LOW_GUESS_MIN_MATCHING_PAIRS`), the entry-test items, the stored practice items (no existing approved item is invalidated or touched; shortening them is content work, C2), the student's pages, the ledger. No migration. No text for the student.
- **Why:** a rule in the validation is cheaper than a content wave: the author sees the warning in `banco work submit --dry-run` and splits the list before the student meets it, and what the teacher approves now shows how many rows the student will face.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/validation/matching_rows_test.rb` (4 rows clean, 5 and 6 warn once, 7 an error with no warning, one instance over the maximum, an old pass keeps its pass with the warning, the thresholds are the file's, a diagnosis matching is not checked, a practice judge of 4 rows is clean, one of 3 is refused, one of 6 warns, a diagnosis judge of 4 is still refused, the card's row count, a new revision of 7 rows fails and one that passed under rules 11 is validated again without the error), `test/validation/code_fixtures_test.rb` (the two codes have a fixture), `test/validation/support_modules_test.rb`, `test/lib/lesson_types_test.rb` and `test/integration/lesson2_api_test.rb` (rules version 12).
## D-367 · 2026-11-19 · honest progress: «già sapevi», «fatti con gli esercizi», hours still to study

- **Design ref:** D-326 (progress counts topics, not skills: the definition of `done` stays), D-328 (`banco progress`, the API of the student's progress), D-340 and D-351 (what a student reads about a skill and a topic), D-348 (the tag «Dal test: da ripassare»), D-364 (the English twin of every student text), D-333 (`banco next`).
- **The student's words (2026-11-18, passed on by the operator):** «il mio percorso non funziona anche se faccio altri esercizi»; and the first-days comments on topics «da riprendere anche se finiti».
- **What the data said (advisory report of 2026-11-19, §S4):** Materie and «I tuoi progressi» showed «19 su 250 (7%)», but 18 of the 19 «done» topics were known from the entry test and never studied. The figure was discouraging and also wrong about what he had done: his own exercises moved it by one.
- **We do:**
  1. **Two counts for every tally** (`Course::StudentView::Tally`, read by Oggi, Materie, Materia, the API and `banco next`): `known`, the done topics whose every skill is still in the state the entry test seeded (demonstrated, `since` equal to the seed's time: no try changed it, so the diagnosis is the only evidence), and `exercises = done - known`, the other done ones (a skill that went to review and came back, or was never seeded, or consolidated, counts with the exercises). The topic status, `done`, `in_progress`, `missing` and `percent` are unchanged; a topic without skills is never «known».
  2. **The time still to study** (`minutes_left` = the sum of the `minutes` of the topics not done; `hours_left` in round hours: under three quarters of an hour is «meno di un'ora», up to 19 h the nearest hour, from 20 h the nearest 5). The pages say «Da studiare ancora: circa 150 ore» and, when nothing is missing, «Non resta niente da studiare.». The percentage bar (`ui_meter`) is gone from the student's pages; `percent` stays in the API only.
  3. **The pages** (`course/_required_lines` shared by Oggi, Materie and Materia): «Obbligatori: N argomenti», «Già sapevi: N», «Fatti con gli esercizi: N», the time line; the optional topics in one line with the same split; each section count on Materia reads two short tags «Già sapevi: N» and «Con gli esercizi: N» (they wrap, D-367 follow-up: a single tag overflowed 390 px in English). **Materia only** adds «Esercizi giusti: N», the right answers (unaided or aided) of the subject's skills from the folded counts (`Course::StudentView#correct_exercises`): a positive unit, nothing counted anew. The keys of the old texts (`progress.required` with «fatti su», `done_of`, `meter`, `today.required`, `today.optional`) are replaced, in Italian and English (`course.{it,en}.yml`).
  4. **The API and the CLI, additive** (`Course::StudentProgress`): every tally also has `known`, `exercises`, `minutes_left`, `hours_left`; each subject and `overall` have `correct_exercises`. No field is removed or changed; `banco progress` prints the JSON, so it shows the same two counts. `done_it` of `banco next` now says «Obbligatori: 250 argomenti. Già sapevi: 18. Fatti con gli esercizi: 1.» (the field stays, its text is the new one).
- **Not done / must not change:** nothing of the engine, the fold, the thresholds, the topic status or the rule that a topic is done when every skill is demonstrated or consolidated (D-326); no row is written and no migration; no model in the student's path; the «per chiudere questo argomento ne mancano N» line of the report is not built (it needs the engine's per-skill missing count on the topic page, D-340, a separate change).
- **Why:** a percentage that counts what the diagnosis found as if it were his work tells him he did nothing; two counts and the time left say what the entry test showed, what he did and what remains, without «sei indietro» and without blame.
- **Status:** implemented.
- **Tests:** `test/integration/honest_progress_test.rb` (the split on Materie, Materia and Oggi with a seeded topic, a seeded skill that went to review, the hours and their rounding, the Italian and English lines, the English pages), `test/integration/student_progress_api_test.rb` (the new fields, a known topic, a topic closed with the exercises), `test/integration/course_pages_test.rb`, `test/integration/civics_view_test.rb`, `test/integration/student_next_api_test.rb` (the new texts), `test/lib/locale_parity_test.rb` (the twins), `test/system/english_walk_test.rb` (the pages stay clean).
